correctness.rationale: Reconstructed full RESULT.md frozen blob 8238471... for all integers d>=2,k>=1,1<=ell<=d-1. An ell-dimensional affine plane admits ell independent coordinate projections, injective on lattice intersection; target nonnegative compositions with sum<=k has C(k+ell,ell). Equality forces preimages for y=0 (extra coordinates a) and y=k e_i (all extras zero); so all extra coordinates are a(1-sum y/k). For k>=2 integrality at y=e_i forces k|a_j; since sum a_j<=k this yields either a=0 or a=k e_j, both face hulls. k=1 follows from integral nonnegative a with sum<=1. Distinct faces count C(d+1,ell+1). Independently enumerated exact rational flats in sample parameters (3,1,2),(3,2,2),(3,3,1),(4,1,2), verifying optima and face-only maximizers. These finite enumerations do not establish all dimensions; projection/integrality proof does.

value.rationale: Natural unimodular simplex is an essential test case for a newly proposed universal maximal-slice counting conjecture. Complete all-dimensional face rigidity identifies a genuine exact-degree counterexample, distinguishes weaker upper-degree variants and helps delimit a mathematically substantive conjecture, despite elementary tools.

final_claim: Every affine ell-plane maximally meeting the lattice of k times a unimodular d-simplex is exactly an ell-face hull; maximum binomial(k+ell,ell) and count binomial(d+1,ell+1), contradicting an exact-degree d-ell conjecture for all polytopes.
limitations: Unimodular simplices with integer k>=1, all affine ell-flats including boundary faces; no conclusion for arbitrary lattice polytopes.
residual_risks: An older general lattice-section face-rigidity lemma might be unindexed; the recent conjecture is not itself a novelty certificate.
Counterexample addresses exact positive degree, not a version interpreted as degree at most d-ell or an interior-plane-only variant.
